svg.title: Proximity Sensor Layout
svg.desc: RoboLore Lesson 5 instructional graphic showing the Zumo 32U4 OLED proximity sensor layout. A compact cutout-style Zumo illustration is embedded unchanged beneath live SVG markers and labels. Four infrared emitters shine forward or sideways, and three detectors look left, front, and right. All instructional labels, markers, callouts, and legend rows remain editable vector elements.

g.text: Visible as the two clear domes.
Mounted on the front sensor array.
Each detector looks in a different
IR emitter ×4 — two forward, two sideways
Ticks show emission or viewing direction

svg.text: Robot illustration based on the Pololu Zumo 32U4 OLED.
